remediation_suggestions.title: Input Validation for Commands
remediation_suggestions.description: Validate and sanitize input used in command execution.
code_examples:
# Python command validation
import subprocess
import shlex

def safe_command_execution(command, user_input):
    # Validate user input
    if not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$', user_input):
        raise ValueError('Invalid input')
    
    # Use shlex for proper escaping
    safe_input = shlex.quote(user_input)
    full_command = f'{command} {safe_input}'
    
    result = subprocess.run(full_command, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return result.stdout
